snippet.title: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out this trailer for A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei, a brand new action game from CangMo Game Entertainment. In this new Action-RPG you play a Jinyiwei (Imperial Guard) in the final days of the Ming Dynasty, using your unqiue deduction ability to move through time to prepare for all potential threats. Using martial arts to defend yourself and take on fearsome foes, you'll untangle a vast web of conspiracy as you uncover the schemes of the various factions on the field. 

A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei is coming soon for PC (Epic Games Store, Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#AWhisperOfFallJinyiwei #ActionRPG #IGN
